value.definition_balanced: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, so what you build reaches people in time. In balance, the fire burns steady. Whether you reach for something new or hold on to the old, the warmth stays.
value.advise_catalyst: What you build earns less than it should, since you seldom ask to be paid for it. Name your price once and hold to it. Put the idea in front of a real buyer this month.
value.advise_friction: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from, the sleep and food and slow fill that come before anything is lit. Let it cool what Fire burns. Whether you are reaching for more or guarding what you have, the heat comes out of your own reserves. Eat before any big choice. Let the numbers wait.
value.advise_balanced: Your fire burns steady while new ventures and old ones both get some of your warmth. Put the idea in front of a real buyer this month. Warm up one old venture you have let go cold.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it steady, a rule that stays once you agree. As a catalyst, the frame runs thin. Little structure comes from outside, and you supply the rest from your own will.
value.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it settled, a frame that stays put. As a friction, the frame closes in. You need to stand right with the rules, and that leaves you little space of your own.
value.definition_balanced: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it steady, a rule that stays once you agree. In balance, the frame holds without closing in. You keep the rules you chose and stand easy inside them.
value.advise_catalyst: You carry every line you live by alone, since few deadlines come to you from outside. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Stay with it through the dull weeks in the middle.
value.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You take each demand as a judgement on yourself. Check each one against what was actually said. Ask what is needed, then do that much and stop.
value.advise_balanced: Your frame holds while the rules you keep are the ones you chose. Keep one promise this week that nobody will check. Stay with one thing you signed up for through its dull middle weeks.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal turns it exact, and what you take in is tested before it is kept. As a catalyst, little flows in from outside. What does reach you is held close and goes deep.
value.definition_friction: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal makes it hard, keeping only what passed a test. As a friction, the test never ends. Nothing feels safe to you until it is right, and making sure eats the hours you meant for living.
value.definition_balanced: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Metal turns it exact, and what you take in is tested before it is kept. In balance, the test is fair and it ends. What passes settles in, and you trust it enough to use it.
value.advise_catalyst: You let in less than the world has to offer, and the gap shows when a question needs more than you hold. Pick one hard question and collect three answers before you decide. Sort what you hear into what you will use now and what can wait. Clear one hour a week for a subject outside your field.
value.advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Action energy. Fire melts what has gone hard, so a checked thought becomes an act and the extra look burns off. Let it spend what Metal stores. Each extra round of care buys you safety and costs you a move. Ship one piece as a draft. Act on one idea within a day of having it.
value.advise_balanced: What you take in and what you test keep pace, and the mix holds while what passes gets put to use. Sort what you hear into what you will use now and what can wait. Put one idea you have tested to work this week.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it flow, and your stamina comes and goes in long stretches. Running thin, the well is shallow. Every push takes from what little you hold, and the bottom comes early.
value.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it deep, and much stays unseen. Running over, the depth has no outlet. Your strength and your wants pile up inside, and you carry more than anyone near you ever sees.
value.definition_balanced: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Water makes it flow, and your stamina comes and goes in long stretches. In balance, the tide goes out and comes back in. You spend and refill in turn, and you never run dry.
value.advise_catalyst: Every push you make draws on a reserve that was small to begin with. Rest a full day after any big push. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it. Hand half of one shared task to a peer.
value.advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. Without a shore your strength either piles up into weight or spills over. Before Sunday, finish one job you have put off. Keep the same day each week for one steady task.
value.advise_balanced: Your stamina holds while every long push is met by an equally long refill. Rest a full day after any big push. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it.
